title: Control Board: the logbook's list grouped and searchable; OSM statement: our Geofabrik copy and today's breaker
why: Jason, 2026-11-19, on the logbook's "whose log" dropdown: "this drop down is very messy." It listed every part the board knows (over a hundred) in one flat list. Now it's grouped by system, the parts with entries this week first with their count, the quiet ones greyed, A to Z in order (W2 before W10), with a box to find a part; the Log an entry picker has the same groups. With it (Jason approved, in the session manager's chat, 2026-11-19): the statement to the OpenStreetMap community says our bulk reading moved to Geofabrik's extracts and states today's breaker and back-off, each line checked against the live code.

log.msg: Plan approved (no switch: everyone at once when published), advancing on schedule.
